blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Our kids multivitamin powder is an organic daily supplement that delivers 15 essential food-derived vitamins and minerals for optimal nutrition, healthy growth and bone development.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Formulated for toddlers one year and older who are eating foods. Mix 1 level scoop daily into juice or food. Mix thoroughly to ensure powder dissolves fully to avoid potential choking hazard. All powders may clump, so full dissolution is important.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: No artificial colors, flavors, sweeteners or preservatives.
No gluten, dairy, soy, peanuts, tree nuts.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Always consult your pediatricians before using any children's products. Do not exceed suggested dosage.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store in a cool, dry place.
Do not use if safety seal is broken or missing.
Note: Contents settle and bottle may appear less than ½ full. Packaged by weight, not volume.
